row_selection.decision: Keep the actual Q without padding. Before timing an exact Q in either DP, batch-check the frozen list on real live-layer donor rows with original and narrow collectives. Separately compare natural, unmodified activations in a fresh admission cohort and the candidate pilot. Unknown Q falls back.
limits: The host planner was run for every row count in the guard. Its only binary tiling key is shared by multiple distinct K plans; device dispatch and equal arithmetic for arbitrary operands do not follow from that key.

Original and candidate at all 12 previously seen Q have the same pair of selected K fields. Other input shapes, tail effects, M/N tiling, data placement and hardware internals can still affect outputs.

The 19 exact Q are a conditional admission set for this frozen workload. Other residuals, partial prompts and a changed speculation or cache policy can fall outside. The optional capped cases are explicit controls.
Native measurements use one chip, replicated source input, original layer-0 weights or an artificial stress panel. Padding cost includes zeroing and contiguous sends, only in the local compute path.

service.timing_scope: A single shared service generation and 19 exact lengths with constructed real-activation donors. Two natural-input shadow cohorts and one selected real-input pilot precede timing. Nine planned timed cases have no OA numerical comparisons. Every arm keeps the same 2.5 GiB bank per worker, actual KV pools and route counters. Output text and workload counters are checked per case. The comparison does not price the long-term cost of the resident banks.

decision: 171 上的 19 种行数在 16 卡、40 层的 12,160 个组合内，构造输入的 pre-OB 输出逐 BF16 字一致。两次自然输入旁路比对和一次实际启用试跑完成后，三组各计时三轮。候选在记录范围内命中 600/600 次卡组层调用。P90 首 token的前参照、候选、后参照中位数为 1.293、1.205、1.212 秒，候选相对前后参照的耗时降幅为 +6.84% / +0.59%，未达到预定门槛。8 请求整轮的前参照、候选、后参照中位数为 15.892、15.937、15.801 秒，候选相对前后参照的耗时降幅为 -0.28% / -0.86%，未达到预定门槛。共 12 轮的 96 个输出与归档文本一致，负载计数吻合。所有实验臂每卡同样预留 2.5 GiB 权重，171 原服务已恢复。
